spec: docs/SPEC.md, the D12 owner spec (2026-09-13, Portuguese, verbatim) and the fourteen Fable addenda beneath it
base_config: experiments/d11/config.json — admission_v2 constants, pons_context_v2 features and scales, pons_encoder_v2 input_schema_sha256, reinforcement.new_full_scale and the clean reference checkpoint are read from there and are NOT restated here. D12 changes the teacher and nothing in that file.

registration.rule: Fable addendum 4. This file and experiments/d12/PLAN.md are committed ALONE, before any D12 number exists. Step (iii) writes the lesson ceiling, the cohort-size distribution, the primary and secondary FROZEN row counts and class balances and the mirror diagnostic — numbers only, no brain — and the brain runs only after step (iii).
registration.nothing_is_re_chosen_after_a_result: no threshold, cutoff, n_min, rule, learning rate or horizon moves after a result is observed. If something cannot be done as specified the deviation is declared in PLAN.md, in the report and in the session log; nothing is absorbed silently.

what_changes: one thing: the teacher. absolute profit reinforcement -> relative cohort reinforcement, in school mode. Everything else is the same object as d11-001.

data.read_only: the store, everything under experiments/d11/ and every D10 artifact are read-only in this wave
data.no_rpc: zero requests; no socket is opened to anything; no live hour; no signing, no funds, no real money

reused_from_d11_001.verification: the sha256 of every reused file is recorded in the d12-001 summary, and at least 200 rows are re-scored under the clean reference and compared with the reused REFERENCE valences at 1e-9 Hz. Seeds and weights are the same, so they must agree exactly; a single disagreement stops the wave.

fixed_for_the_whole_wave.decoder: the stored k = 8 decoder, baseline -0.844389816810345 Hz, theta 0.9117185769796697 Hz
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.forgetting: never called; a frozen branch's end digest must equal its start digest and a test asserts it
fixed_for_the_whole_wave.same_split_as_d11_001: t0 = timestamp(start_block), T = t0 + floor(0.7 * (t1 - t0)) snapped down to the 30-second grid anchored at t0 — computed by experiments/d11/common.py split() from the store's own MANIFEST and asserted equal to the recorded d11-001 split

reinforcement.selector: flytrade.pons.reinforcement.rule_from_config reads reinforcement.rule. A configuration without the key — every D5-D11 configuration — selects absolute_profit_v1, which is the existing path, byte-identical.
reinforcement.absolute_profit_v1: valence = sign(net return on notional), amount = min(|r| / reinforce_full_scale, reinforce_cap). Unchanged, untouched, and still what a D10 or D11 configuration takes.

relative_cohort_v1.cohort: the admission_v2-eligible candidates of ONE tick that have a settled evaluator label. A member whose label is UNRESOLVED leaves the cohort and is counted.
relative_cohort_v1.n_below_min: no lesson at all for that cohort, counted as COHORT_TOO_SMALL
relative_cohort_v1.rank: ascending by the label's integer net_wei, average ranks for ties; rank 1 is the worst net
relative_cohort_v1.signal: s_i = 2 * (rank_i - 1) / (n - 1) - 1, in [-1, +1]; worst -1, best +1, mean exactly 0 per cohort
relative_cohort_v1.valence_and_amount: s > 0 -> reward of amount |s|; s < 0 -> punishment of amount |s|; s == 0 -> neutral, no update (the existing neutral treatment)
relative_cohort_v1.no_clipping: no clipping can occur. REINFORCE_CAP and reinforce_full_scale are not consulted by this rule and appear nowhere in its arithmetic.
relative_cohort_v1.why_rank_and_not_z_score: scale-free, immune to the tail that saturated two calibrations, and zero-mean by construction
relative_cohort_v1.the_two_columns_are_never_merged: the financial net (wei) and the pedagogical signal s are two columns on every LESSON record. A cohort in which every member lost money still teaches which member lost least. This is relative/cohort reinforcement and is never called a profit reward; no profit is falsified and the net is reported as it is.

reinforcement.the_plasticity_rule_does_not_change: the same CreditAssigner.settle -> MushroomBody.proposed_gain_delta path, the same learning rate, the same floor, the same mean-of-k-deltas normalisation. Only where sign and amount come from, and what triggers an update, are new.

school_mode.no_position: the LEARNING branch opens no paper position and holds none. There is no bankroll, no entry, no exit and no PnL in the school.
school_mode.presentation: at every LEARNING tick every admission_v2-eligible candidate is presented — no cap of six, no rotation, no hold mode — through the standard readout (k = 8, comparison_v1, seeds from (observation_id, stable_id, replicate), not from the learned state) and decoded once by the stored k = 8 decoder
school_mode.trace: each presented candidate's eligibility trace set — the k traces BrainRunner.evaluate_round already builds for every candidate, the same object the D11 learning path stores for the one it bought — is kept as a pending lesson keyed (cutoff_ts, stable_id)
school_mode.maturity_rule: a lesson matures at the first tick whose cutoff >= lesson cutoff + 902 s (latency 2 + horizon 900). 902 is not a multiple of the 30 s cadence, so that tick is always lesson cutoff + 930 s — 28 s after the outcome the lesson is computed from.
school_mode.application_order: matured lessons of one cohort are applied together, in stable_id order, BEFORE that tick's presentations
school_mode.boundary: a lesson whose cutoff + 902 > T is discarded, counted as BOUNDARY and never applied. No lesson is ever applied at a FROZEN tick; the school replay does not run one.
school_mode.queue: bounded by construction at 31 ticks of lessons; its size, the lessons applied and the lessons discarded by reason are recorded per tick

records.ROUND: for every presented candidate, as today
records.checkpoint_cadence: the durable checkpoint file is written every 500 applied lessons and at the end of the partition. The digest recorded on every LESSON record is the in-memory digest of the weights immediately after that lesson, so the weight history is auditable without a file write per lesson. Declared here, before the run.
records.final_checkpoint: SCHOOL; its digest is recorded in the run summary and in the scoring manifest

quantities: Pearson r, Spearman rho and Kendall tau between trained and reference valence
OLS trained = a + b * reference with R^2
the fraction of row pairs whose order is reversed
the same per temporal block and within tick (cohort-wise tau, the quantity that matters for ranking)
AUC(-reference) beside AUC(trained), and the residual of AUC(trained) from 1 - AUC(reference)
mirror_diagnostic.wording: numbers. The mechanistic reading — fifteen punishments depressed the approach pathway in proportion to the prior valence, so the trained valence is a decreasing affine function of the untrained one — is a HYPOTHESIS that the slope b and tau test. It is not a finding until stated as one by the owner.

grids.machinery: the same grid as d11-001: rows keyed (cutoff_ts, stable_id), built once from the store alone, identical across branches by construction

primary.definition: FROZEN rows on tokens that were NEVER a lesson — tokens whose first admission_v2 eligibility is at a tick >= T
primary.why: the owner's 'tokens posteriores que ela nunca recebeu como aula'
primary.enforced_by: token address, asserted disjoint from the set of tokens that appear on any LESSON record by a test

branches.REFERENCE: the clean brain; its scores are reused from d11-001 with the 200-row recomputation check

grids.read_only: both brains are loaded read-only and their digests are verified before and after every scoring pass. No execution, no bankroll, no reinforcement and no checkpoint write happens in a scoring pass.

statistics.primary: dAUC = AUC(SCHOOL) - AUC(REFERENCE), over rows VALID in both branches that carry a settled label
statistics.auc: Mann-Whitney U / (n_pos * n_neg), ties counted one half

uncertainty.method: paired cluster bootstrap by stable_id — a token's rows move together
uncertainty.reported: overall and per temporal block, on the primary and on the secondary grid

preregistered_readings.entirely_above_zero: the school-trained ranking of later tokens is higher than the untrained one, not compatible with sampling variation

statistics.wording_rule: never 'significant', never 'proves', no rate asserted as measured. An AUC near 0.5 is not evidence that no signal exists. A lower BUY rate alone is not learning success. Profit is not learning.
secondary_descriptive: the distribution of the per-row score difference SCHOOL - REFERENCE
the suppression check: BUY-crossing rate (valence > theta) per branch, overall, per block and by later outcome class
known_answer_tests: AUC 1, 0 and 0.5 on perfect, reversed and constant toy data
an exact negative in the mirror diagnostic -> tau = -1 and b = -1

per_lesson: the s that arrives 902 s later
every_500_applied_lessons: the mean within-cohort Kendall tau between valence and s
the plastic KC->MBON weights: mean, L2 norm, fraction at the floor (gain <= 0.25 + 1e-9), fraction at the ceiling (gain >= 1.0 - 1e-9), and the checkpoint digest
learning_curve_and_weights.prospective_by_construction: the brain has not yet been taught those lessons when it scores them
learning_curve_and_weights.a_property_of_the_operator_registered_be: the plasticity rule only depresses, the clean reference starts with every gain exactly at 1.0, and the ceiling is 1.0. A synapse 'at the ceiling' is therefore a synapse no lesson has ever depressed. The floor fraction and the ceiling fraction are reported separately as well as summed; the split is additive and loosens nothing.

verbatim_from_addendum_9: fewer than 100 paired labels on the primary grid
either outcome class under 20 on the primary grid
encoder saturation over 5 % of (row, channel) pairs or INVALID_STATE over 5 %
more than 25 % of plastic synapses at floor or ceiling at the end of LEARNING

operationalised.lessons_applied: LESSON records whose update was accepted by the CreditAssigner, plus the neutral s == 0 lessons, which are applied lessons that move nothing; both counts are reported and the condition reads the total
operationalised.paired_labels: grid rows VALID in both branches with a settled (non-UNRESOLVED) label
operationalised.class_counts: positive = net > 0, negative = net <= 0, over the paired labelled rows of the primary grid
operationalised.paired_coverage: rows VALID in both branches / all grid rows
operationalised.saturation: the (row, channel) saturated fraction, |tanh(raw/scale)| >= 1 - 1e-12, over all grid rows
operationalised.weight_saturation: the fraction of the 44,042 plastic KC->MBON gains at the floor or at the ceiling at the final SCHOOL checkpoint

inconclusive_conditions.do_not_loosen: these thresholds are not loosened after the run. Three are pre-computable and are checked in step (iii): a lesson ceiling under 2,000, a primary grid under 100 labelled rows, or a class under 20 ends the wave with the numbers and no neural run.

determinism.rule: the first 100 LEARNING ticks of the school replay, run twice from the clean reference, give an identical checkpoint digest and an identical sha256 of the LESSON log

frozen_loop_branches.what_they_are: two FROZEN replays over the FROZEN partition with paper trading as in d11-001 — one position at a time, SETTLED_FROZEN settlements, no LEARNING record, end digest equal to start digest
frozen_loop_branches.they_are_descriptive: their PnL and action frequencies are the paper results of this wave. They are NOT the primary comparison and they do not decide which observations the grid contains.

layout.no_entry_point_opens_a_socket: a test parses every D12 script for flytrade.pons.rpc and for network verbs, and none is allowed to name one
layout.untouched: experiments/d10, experiments/d11, data/pons, upstream, tests/upstream_audit, experiments/d7, d8, d9b and experiments/historical/runs do not change in this wave; the close asserts the diff against a661cbb is empty

success_is_not: a profit, a win rate or a BUY frequency
any claim that the fly learned because it made money
what_it_cannot_say: a difference between SCHOOL and REFERENCE here is a difference between one brain that saw 8.4 hours of school on this window and one that saw none. It cannot be compared with d10-001. It is compared with d11-001 only on the secondary grid — the same rows, the same labels, the same reference scores — and that comparison is descriptive.
